class:
Provides stream encryption in fixed-size chunks, where each encrypted chunk carries its own AES-256-GCM authentication tag.
Nonce derivation follows the TLS 1.3 construction: nonce_i = initial_nonce XOR (0x00000000 || uint64_be(i))
Each encrypted frame layout: counter_le64[8] | ciphertext[N] | tag[16]
The initial nonce and chunk size must be stored in the CMS message info custom params by the caller; they are not embedded in the ciphertext stream.
Set the 32-byte AES-256 encryption key.
Set the 12-byte initial nonce for decryption. Not needed for encryption: nonce is generated automatically in start_encryption.
Set the plaintext chunk size in bytes. Default is 65536.
Return the 12-byte initial nonce. Valid after calling start_encryption; store in CMS custom params for decryption.
Return nonce length in bytes (always 12).
Return buffer length required to hold output of process_encryption and finish_encryption.
Initiate encryption. Generates a random 12-byte initial nonce.
Process encryption of a new portion of data.
Encrypt any remaining pending data and finalize the stream.
Return buffer length required to hold output of process_decryption and finish_decryption.
Initiate decryption. Caller must call set_nonce with the initial nonce from CMS before this.
Process decryption of a new portion of data.
Decrypt any remaining pending data and finalize the stream.
Encrypt one plaintext chunk and write frame: counter_le64[8] | ciphertext | tag[16].
Authenticate and decrypt one ciphertext frame: counter_le64[8] | ciphertext | tag[16].
